stem.text: The diagram shows some of the effects of nicotine and carbon monoxide in cigarette smoke.

stem.alt: Three overlapping circles labelled 1, 2 and 3. The overlap of circles 1 and 2 is labelled nicotine and the overlap of circles 2 and 3 is labelled carbon monoxide.

A.text: increase in heart rate; short-term effect on cardiovascular system; combines more readily with haemoglobin than oxygen

B.text: increases diameter of small arteries; can cause chronic bronchitis; combines irreversibly with haemoglobin

C.text: reduces the oxygen carrying capacity of blood; short-term effect on gas exchange system; reduces the blood supply to hands and feet

D.text: stimulates goblet cells to secrete more mucus; highly addictive; increases risk of blood clotting
